title: MV Will-o’-the-wisp.   First game on RPG Maker / Problems with itch.io

posts.author: Canine_Noir
posts.body:
Hi everyone!
I am developing my very first game using RPG Maker MV:
https://canine-noir.itch.io/will-o-the-wisp
I'd be thrilled if you could check it out, share your impressions, and give me some advice on how to improve the project (like recommending cool plugins or new mechanics).
Will-o'-the-wisp
is a dark atmospheric puzzle game where you take on the role of a fragile light lost in an endless dark labyrinth. Step by step, you will have to piece together the story of this eerie place and find out exactly how you ended up here.
The core gameplay is centered around survival: the glow around the hero is constantly decreasing, narrowing the field of view. You will have to balance on the edge of total darkness, calculate every step, and look for energy sources, because if the light goes out, the character will die. To unravel the mystery and find a way out of this nightmare, the player will have to solve spatial puzzles and listen to the whispers of ghosts from the past, who can either help you or deliberately confuse you.
My goal was to create something unconventional for this engine. At first glance, it might look like a simple maze, but that is just a backdrop for the story. The narrative is driven by the environment, sound design, and visuals. Every single detail is tied to the lore — there are absolutely no random or thoughtless elements.
You can find a more detailed description on the itch.io page.
Your feedback means the world to me, as it will help me decide whether to keep working on this game and pursuing game development.
Note: AI was used to generate 2 images for this game.
I've also run into an issue with itch.io. I published the game 21 days ago, but it's still completely invisible in both search results and the "Recent" section. I read that this could be due to the game undergoing a manual review, but it's been almost two weeks now. I reached out to itch.io support six days ago, but haven't received a reply yet. Has anyone experienced a similar issue? I would really appreciate any advice or insight on how to fix this!
